outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is parallel_only_pass. The parallel-mode run passed all 594 tests after creating a full DictDataBase workspace from the reference sources, adapting __init__.py, installing the package, smoke-testing APIs, and running pytest. The serial control failed because the recorded final artifact was empty after a timeout; the visible second attempt was still reading reference source files when the turn was cancelled, and the status shows an earlier retryable attempt had already consumed most of the cell budget. This difference is directly evidenced as a completion and artifact-lifecycle divergence, not as a concurrency pattern, because the parallel run had swarm mode enabled but no actual child agents or delegation.
parallel_contributors: The main agent copied the full reference project into /workspace and made the required __init__.py API adaptation.
The main agent installed the package, ran a smoke test, and observed 594 passing tests before final response.
serial_contributors: The serial cell spent 2007.828 seconds in a retryable first attempt and then the visible second attempt timed out after 352.912 seconds.
The visible serial attempt ended during source-file inspection before any workspace files were assembled, leaving artifact_validation files empty.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel used the upstream DictDataBase source and a small export-order fix; serial never reached an implementation state where ordinary code defects could be evaluated.
The successful path depended on discovering and copying the complete upstream project, whereas the failed path remained in investigation and source reading.
evaluator_effects: The completed official evaluation scored the empty serial artifact as zero of 594 rather than exposing individual testcase failures in the status summary.
